sources.title: 《叢書集成初編》商務排印《明史藝文志》卷三書內五二頁：陸位後《星學大成》十八卷
sources.provider: NLC416 digital scan at Wikimedia Commons, printed Commercial Press Congshu Jicheng Chubian page
sources.quality_notes: PDF zero-index page55/printed 52 shows 萬民育三命會通十二卷 followed by 陸位星學綱目正傳二十卷 星學大成十八卷. Frontmatter pdf indices1-3 identifies 商務印書館 叢書集成初編 and 本館據八史經籍志本排印; not a Ming/Qing original or direct Ming author manuscript. This modern reprint's old source edition/print date and its relation to received MingShi v98 Wan attribution unresolved. No source folio image hash acquired.
